pg082_n0007: In this chapter, you will learn about the measurements of length, mass and volume.
pg082_n0008: You will also be able to estimate and compare lengths, masses and volumes of different objects.
pg082_n0009: The competencies developed will enable you to perform different activities related to measurements of length, mass, and volume.
pg082_n0013: Length is the distance between two points.
pg082_n0014: It can be measured by using different tools.
pg082_n0015: The measuring tools of length are of two types, namely non-standard and standard tools.
pg082_n0019: The use of non-standard measuring tools of length depends on the type of objects being measured.
pg082_n0020: For example, the length of a chalkboard or table can be measured using non-standard tools such as handspan, stick, rope or footsteps.
pg082_n0022: Non-standard tools like a handspan do not give exact measurements because the obtained length will depend on the size of the person’s handspan.
pg082_n0023: If two persons with different handspans measure the same table, they will get different lengths.
pg082_n0025: Therefore, a handspan is a non-standard tool.

pg083_n0024: Standard tools for measuring length provide exact results which are acceptable worldwide.

pg083_n0026: These tools give measurements in metric units.
pg083_n0027: The common metric units of length include millimetres (mm), centimetres (cm), metres (m) and kilometres (km).

pg136_n0007: In this chapter, you will learn about time measurements.
pg136_n0008: You will read the time in 12-hour and 24-hour formats.
pg136_n0009: You will also learn how to recognise the number of hours in a day, days in a week, weeks in a month, and months in a year.
pg136_n0010: The competencies developed will enable you to manage time and be punctual in various scheduled activities.
pg136_n0011: Examples of such activities include keeping a record of school, media and transport schedules.
pg136_n0015: Time is measured in seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months or years.
pg136_n0016: The relationship between the units of time is as follows:
pg136_n0020: There are 60 seconds in one minute.
pg136_n0023: There are 60 minutes in one hour.
pg136_n0026: There are 24 hours in one day.
pg136_n0029: There are 7 days in one week.
pg136_n0032: There are 12 months in one year.

pg137_n0009: A calendar is used for measuring days, weeks and months of a year.
